card.name: Underlying cause of a symptom
card.fires_on: Nouns like cause, medical, conditions or pathology that name the underlying reason or illness behind a symptom, usually in advice to find out or rule out what is behind it.

modes.label: Find the cause
modes.description: The word cause after 'find out the' or 'depends on the' when a symptom needs explaining.
modes.example: Your healthcare provider should check any unusual vaginal bleeding to find out the<< cause>>.

modes.label: Other medical problem
modes.description: Words like medical, conditions or pathology naming another underlying illness to be evaluated.
modes.example: may indicate the presence of a primary psychiatric and/or<< medical>> illness that should be evaluated
